text.content:
The Valentinos' living room. Be polite.

Region: The Glen, Heywood (#32)
Controlled by: A Valentino family; Rosa Delgado owns it
The feel of it: Real food, good tequila, and Valentino business at the back tables
Danger: SC 7: Valentinos, Hardened Light

A cantina owned by a Valentino family. Show respect here and at La Catrina and you'll probably walk out of Heywood.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 10
